verdict.rationale: Termius docs confirm SSH key creation and management with passphrase protection, encrypted storage, and cross-device sync (termius-docs-12), plus Keychain referencing for password-less host access (termius-docs-3, termius-docs-19). However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm key-pair generation for password-less authentication setup (e.g., pushing public key to servers) and community feedback raises concerns about storing keys on third-party servers (termius-comm-13). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the key-generation workflow and public-key deployment to servers, independent hands-on verification of the feature working as described.
